anonymity_rule: Do not infer or seek actor identities, model families, effort levels, earlier drafts, or earlier review outcomes. Review only the supplied evidence.
learner_baseline: The learner is an ungrounded, unembodied 1.2B model. Assume zero bankable semantics, grammar, discourse, world knowledge, identity grounding, common sense, interface convention, or human childhood experience.

lesson_context.point: Actual Lesson 000 staged bootstrap: greeting, copular self-identification, affirmative and negative identity, Who, OR, and meeting reciprocity. Each form must be modeled locally immediately before its controlled gate.
lesson_context.world_objective: The names Ninereeds, Taro, Emma, Bob, and Errol remain stable across the source presentation and its noncanonical drills.
lesson_context.structural_exception: L000 is the sole staged nonlexical exception and has zero vocabulary items. Greeting and participant self-identification form the bootstrap for the affirmative gate.

review_requirements: Inspect every modeled turn, base and reserve exercise, mixed order, story turn, comprehension demonstration/test, intervention, replay, alarm, budget, and asset binding.

Verify the frozen execution_sequence is exhaustive and interleaves greeting/self-identification/affirmative models with affirmative practice, then each later local model immediately with its own negative, W-question, OR-question, or reciprocity gate.
Verify no later gate form is exposed before its local model and every PRESENT_AGAIN action returns only to the failed gate's bound local model.
Verify both nonverbal story checks use contrastive worked speaker-attribution demonstrations understandable without spoken instructions or pre-existing interface conventions.
Verify TRAIN_MORE reserves are genuinely additional Point-safe prompts rather than copies of the base prompts.
Inspect exact pixels when material; judge learner-facing language and machine-control learnability against the zero-convention baseline.
Check the eight pages are one persistent identity-verification event and all scored first-person learner output remains Ninereeds as Ninereeds.
Check every adaptive branch, stopping rule, replay, alarm, and budget is total and mechanically evaluable.
Return revise for any non-waterproof defect with exact owning-stage repair; do not rewrite the lesson.
